# ship-specs

Your interface to the `specs` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`specs.list`](references/docs/specs.list.mdoc) — Raw spec records from the DB.
- [`specs.get`](references/docs/specs.get.mdoc) — Full spec record + body.
- [`specs.summaries`](references/docs/specs.summaries.mdoc) — Rail shape: grouped + counts + pipelines.
- [`specs.detail`](references/docs/specs.detail.mdoc) — Full view-shaped spec detail: parsed sections, launch ctx.
